request.note: No payload. The handler reads no field.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: You were alive. There is no `game_response`.
responses.summary: Your state (`resend "u+cid"`) with `rip: true` (or the name of your gravestone cosmetic) and `hp: 0`.

confirm.note: `rip` sets `hp: 0`, `rip: true`, `moving: false`, `abs: true`; `player_to_client` swaps `rip` for the gravestone cosmetic when there is one; `"cid"` bumps `cid`

rows.when: No character, or you are dead already (`player.rip`).

also.to: everyone in the instance of the attacker
also.when: Not on a generated map, and a different character hit you recently (`s.block.f`). That character gets the PvP kill and its rewards (`issue_player_award`).
As for `server_message`, when you are on the `arena` map.
also.summary: The same text with phrase `server.chat_log.defeated`, as a `LocalizedText` with `owner` (the name of the NPC) and `id: "pvp"`.

also.when: You are in a party: `rip` sends the new party state to each member, you too. On every call that gets past the checks (`rip` runs in `defeat_player` or right after it).
also.summary: `{list, party}`: the names and the state of the party. See the `party_update` entry.

also.when: After the death, every client whose view holds you (you included).

fields.name: args
fields.description: `{c: "#6F76A6", sz: "huge"}`: the color and the size.

order: PvP kill only: `server_message` to the instance of the attacker (and `chat_log` in the arena)
party only: `party_update` to each member, you too
